rowan: heads-up — onboarding sample showed different inference types between local node and the edge bundle. generics from our wrapper become `any`.

sasha: can you paste the minimal repro? is it the retry/auth wrapper or the sdk call itself?

rowan: it's a small wrapper: `function wrap<T>(fn: ()=>Promise<T>): Promise<T>; function wrap(fn){ return withRetry(fn) }` then `const u = await wrap(()=> sdk.fetchUser<{id:string}>(id))` — node dev: `u.id` is string, edge bundle: `u` is `any`.

marc: likely resolution: the bundler rewrites d.ts imports and picks the CJS fallback types. conditional exports + `export =` in the SDK cause the bundler to flatten signatures, losing overload clarity.

ivy: short fixes: 1) avoid overloads for wrappers (single generic signature) 2) pin sample tsconfig to `moduleResolution: node` or explicit `types` path in package exports for edge.

rowan: added a tiny repro and PR that pins moduleResolution for the quickstart and replaces the overload with `wrap<T>(fn: ()=>Promise<T>, opts?:{})` in sample code. CI shows edge bundle typecheck now green.

pkg-bot: summary: node-cjs typecheck: OK. edge-bundle typecheck: failed on master at 2743211000; branch `devex/edge-typing-resolve` passes.

sasha: long term: SDK should consolidate declaration shapes (no dual `export =` + ESM `export`), and add an edge-specific types entry or CI that runs the real bundler + `tsc` to catch these early. also, lint samples to forbid `as any`.

rowan: thanks — will update onboarding docs with a short "Edge bundlers & TS" note and link the PR.
